value: Lady Sacrolash and Grand Warlock Alythess stand together before the deeper halls. Their crimson and violet powers guard the way toward M’uru. Together, the Eredar Twins form one last wall between the Offensive and the fount.
editorNote: Names and paired encounter are direct from the raid index; motives are omitted. Composite figure art is limited to this paired scene. Record remains research. Original-client and human source review are still required; no record is promoted to reviewed or published.
